quotes.text: "Legacy single-byte encodings (invalid UTF-8) should safely fall back to ISO-8859-1"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: fixEncoding keeps escaped dollar-hex pairs literal and decodes each contiguous unescaped sequence with a per-parser fatal UTF-8 decoder. If decoding fails, the whole sequence falls back to one character per byte. This is a bounded fallback, not charset detection. The regression directly checks separate UTF-8 and single-byte values plus escaped-pair cases; it does not exhaust mixed invalid sequences. No parser run was performed.
title: Mork byte decoding falls back for a whole failing contiguous sequence
